other_failure_modes.name: Validation Data Leakage (CV Leakage)
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates dataset-level statistics (e.g., median imputation, frequency encoding, groupby aggregations, and TF-IDF/SVD) on the entire training set before performing cross-validation splits. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, leading to overly optimistic out-of-fold validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Test Set Leakage in Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the unique categories of the test dataset to construct the index mapping for categorical encoding. In a real-world setting, future test data categories are unknown, making this an unrealistic assumption.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated pipeline with out-of-fold target encoding, TF-IDF SVD features, and an ensemble with optimized weights. However, it suffers from internal data leakage because several global transformations (like median imputation, frequency encoding, and groupby aggregations) are applied to the entire training set before the CV split. Furthermore, the agent ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a randomized StratifiedKFold, and evaluates strictly on a single metric.
